mode.title: Mode
mode.description: exact: full expression; partial: consecutive keyword fragments; similar: legacy token/variant rules. Use exact or partial with explicit normalization options for the current UI behavior.

exact_relaxed.title: Exact Relaxed
exact_relaxed.description: Legacy bundled option. Independent options take precedence when provided.

strip_bracket_notes.title: Strip Bracket Notes
strip_bracket_notes.description: Exclude parenthetical notes from the keyword used for exact/partial comparison.

normalize_whitespace.title: Normalize Whitespace
normalize_whitespace.description: Ignore spaces, line breaks and invisible whitespace while comparing.

normalize_symbols.title: Normalize Symbols
normalize_symbols.description: Replace configured symbols with spaces independently of whitespace normalization.

partial_min_len.title: Partial Min Len
partial_min_len.description: Minimum consecutive fragment length for partial mode, after selected normalization.
